claims.assertion: The review gate reproduced #820s three known findings AND surfaced two unknown #824 findings (shadow weather SMS P1, fake trigger ids P2) from the real GitHub API; both #824 findings are fixed in this same PR.

P1: the repair request path queues durably and calls no provider (worker renders on the pulse); P2: queueing invalidates the stale mp4 into history and nulls it; P2: every provider attempt reserves fresh (rep_x_p1 failed -> rep_x_p2), never reusing a failed reservation.
The planner uses the new PURE evaluateWeatherTriggers (zero SMS/alert side effects; source scan forbids the side-effecting path) and playbook trigger ids match the real emitted set.
